name: Quick Attack
official: Normal | Physical | Power 40 | Accuracy 100% | PP 30 | Priority +1 | Contact
description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

name: Body Slam
official: Normal | Physical | Power 85 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | 30% paralysis | Contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 30% (-4) chance of applying the Paralysis condition to the target.
description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: Iron Head
official: Steel | Physical | Power 80 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | 30% flinch | Contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 30% (-4) chance of applying the Flinch condition to the target.
description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

name: Crunch
official: Dark | Physical | Power 80 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | 20% chance to lower target’s Defense | Contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 20% (-6) chance of applying a Defense debuff of one stage (-2 Defense) to the target.
description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

name: Close Combat
official: Fighting | Physical | Power 120 | Accuracy 100% | PP 5 | Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage | Contact
secondaryEffects: Applies a Defense debuff of one stage (-2) and a Special defense debuff of one stage (-2) to the user.
description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

name: Earthquake
official: Ground | Physical | Power 100 | Accuracy 100% | PP 10 | Hits all adjacent Pokémon | No contact
description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

name: Seismic Toss
official: Fighting | Physical | Power — | Accuracy 100% | PP 20 | Deals damage equal to the user’s level | Contact
power: Equal to half the user’s level (rounded up), to a maximum of 20.
description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

name: Fly
official: Flying | Physical | Power 90 | Accuracy 95% | PP 15 | User flies up on the first turn, dodging attacks, and strikes on the second | Contact
otherEffects: On the turn the Move is charged, the user has Advantage (+4) to Evasion. While the Move is charged, the user has the Flight Ability if they don’t have it already.
description: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

name: Surf
official: Water | Special | Power 90 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | Hits all adjacent Pokémon | No contact
shapeSize: 2 m + half the user’s Special attack
description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

name: Thunderbolt
official: Electric | Special | Power 90 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | 10% paralysis | No contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 10% (-8) chance of applying the Paralysis condition to the target.
description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: Thunder
official: Electric | Special | Power 110 | Accuracy 70% | PP 10 | 10% paralysis | No contact | Accuracy 100% in Rain, 50% in Harsh Sunlight
secondaryEffects: Has a 10% (-8) chance of applying the Paralysis condition to the target.
otherEffects: During Rain, the Move’s Accuracy modifier is +10. During Harsh Sunlight, the Move’s Accuracy modifier is +0.
description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: Flamethrower
official: Fire | Special | Power 90 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | 10% burn | No contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 10% (-8) chance of applying the Burn condition to the target.
description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: Ice Beam
official: Ice | Special | Power 90 | Accuracy 100% | PP 10 | 10% freeze | No contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 10% (-8) chance of applying the Freeze condition to the target.
description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

name: Blizzard
official: Ice | Special | Power 110 | Accuracy 70% | PP 5 | 10% freeze | Hits all foes | No contact | Never misses during Snow
secondaryEffects: Has a 10% (-8) chance of applying the Freeze condition to the target.
otherEffects: During Snow, the To-Hit test succeeds automatically against all targets.
description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

name: Hyper Beam
official: Normal | Special | Power 150 | Accuracy 90% | PP 5 | User must recharge on the following turn | No contact
description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

name: Solar Beam
official: Grass | Special | Power 125 | Accuracy 100% | PP 10 | Charges on the first turn, attacks on the second | No contact | Instant in Harsh Sunlight; damage halved in other weather
otherEffects: Does not need to be charged during Harsh Sunlight weather condition. During Rain, Sandstorm, Snow or Fog weather conditions, the Move’s Power is halved.
description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

name: Thunder Wave
official: Electric | Status | Accuracy 90% | PP 20 | Paralyzes the target | No contact
otherEffects: Applies the Paralysis condition to the target.
description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

name: Will-O-Wisp
official: Fire | Status | Accuracy 85% | PP 15 | Burns the target | No contact
otherEffects: Applies the Burn condition to the target.
description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

name: Toxic
official: Poison | Status | Accuracy 90% | PP 10 | Badly poisons the target | No contact | Never misses when used by a Poison-type
otherEffects: Applies the Badly poisoned condition to the target. If the user is a Poison-type character, the To-Hit test succeeds automatically.
description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

name: Swords Dance
official: Normal | Status | PP 20 | Raises the user’s Attack by two stages | Self
otherEffects: Applies an Attack buff of two stages (+4) to the user.
description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

name: Recover
official: Normal | Status | PP 10 | Restores 50% of the user’s max HP | Self
otherEffects: Restores HP equal to the user’s Health * 2.
description: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.

name: Rain Dance
official: Water | Status | PP 5 | Sets Rain | Entire field
otherEffects: Sets the Rain weather condition in the area. The weather condition lasts for 1 hour and removes all previous weather conditions from the area.
description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

name: Sunny Day
official: Fire | Status | PP 5 | Sets Harsh Sunlight | Entire field
otherEffects: Sets the Harsh Sunlight weather condition in the area. The weather condition lasts for 1 hour and removes all previous weather conditions from the area.
description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

name: Trick Room
official: Psychic | Status | Power — | Accuracy — | PP 5 | Priority -7 | Reverses the turn order within each priority bracket so slower Pokémon act first for 5 turns (using it counts as the first); using it again while its effect is active ends the effect | Entire field
otherEffects: When a round starts, this Move can be used to reverse the turn order. Initiative modifiers of affected characters are ignored while the effect lasts. Priority Turns are still taken before normal turns, but their order is also reversed. The effect lasts for 5 rounds. If this Move is used while its effect is active, the effect ends instead.
description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

name: Stealth Rock
official: Rock | Status | Power — | Accuracy — | PP 20 | Sets a hazard on the target field; Pokémon switching in take damage equal to 12.5% of their max HP, multiplied by Rock’s type effectiveness | No contact
otherEffects: Creates an area that lasts for 5 rounds. A character that enters the area or is inside the area during their End Phase takes 4 True Damage. A character can be affected by this Move only once per round.
description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: Brave Bird
official: Flying | Physical | Power 120 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil | Contact
secondaryEffects: The user takes True Damage equal to one third of the damage dealt (rounded up).
description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

name: Play Rough
official: Fairy | Physical | Power 90 | Accuracy 90% | PP 10 | 10% chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage | Contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 10% (-8) chance of applying an Attack debuff of one stage (-2 Attack) to the target.
description: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

name: Moonblast
official: Fairy | Special | Power 95 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | 30% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage | No contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 30% (-4) chance of applying a Special Defense debuff of one stage (-2 Special Defense) to the target.
description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

name: Shadow Ball
official: Ghost | Special | Power 80 | Accuracy 100% | PP 15 | 20% chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage | No contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 20% (-6) chance of applying a Special Defense debuff of one stage (-2 Special Defense) to the target.
description: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: Drain Punch
official: Fighting | Physical | Power 75 | Accuracy 100% | PP 10 | Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user | Contact
secondaryEffects: Restores the user’s HP equal to half of the damage dealt (rounded up).
description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

name: Giga Drain
official: Grass | Special | Power 75 | Accuracy 100% | PP 10 | Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user | No contact
secondaryEffects: Restores the user’s HP equal to half of the damage dealt (rounded up).
description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

name: Ice Shard
official: Ice | Physical | Power 40 | Accuracy 100% | PP 30 | Priority +1 | No contact
description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

name: Mach Punch
official: Fighting | Physical | Power 40 | Accuracy 100% | PP 30 | Priority +1 | Contact
description: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

name: Extreme Speed
official: Normal | Physical | Power 80 | Accuracy 100% | PP 5 | Priority +2 | Contact
description: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

name: Aqua Jet
official: Water | Physical | Power 40 | Accuracy 100% | PP 20 | Priority +1 | Contact
description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

name: Dig
official: Ground | Physical | Power 80 | Accuracy 100% | PP 10 | User digs underground on the first turn, dodging attacks, and strikes on the second | Contact
otherEffects: On the turn the Move is charged, the user has Advantage (+4) to Evasion. While the Move is charged, the user has the Burrower Ability if they don’t have it already.
description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

name: Phantom Force
official: Ghost | Physical | Power 90 | Accuracy 100% | PP 10 | User vanishes on the first turn, dodging attacks, and strikes on the second; hits through Protect and Detect | Contact
otherEffects: On the turn the Move is charged, the user has Advantage (+4) to Evasion. While the Move is charged, the user is ghostly, as described by the Incorporeal Ability. The target does not benefit from positive modifiers to their Defense Power against this Move.
description: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

name: Whirlwind
official: Normal | Status | Accuracy — | PP 20 | Priority -6 | Forces the target to switch out | No contact
otherEffects: The target is forcibly moved 2d6 meters away from the user. Then all characters except the user within 12 meters of the target’s original location are forcibly moved 2d6 meters towards it.
description: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

name: Dragon Tail
official: Dragon | Physical | Power 60 | Accuracy 90% | PP 10 | Priority -6 | Damages the target and forces it to switch out | Contact
otherEffects: The target is forcibly moved 5 meters away from the user.
description: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

name: Baton Pass
official: Normal | Status | Accuracy — | PP 40 | The user switches out, passing its stat stage changes to the replacement | Self
otherEffects: The user and the target get free Movement Actions that they have to use to move to each other’s positions. Then the user gives all their buffs and debuffs to the target.
description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

name: Bounce
official: Flying | Physical | Power 85 | Accuracy 85% | PP 5 | User bounces high into the air on the first turn, dodging attacks, and strikes on the second; 30% paralysis | Contact
secondaryEffects: Has a 30% (-4) chance of applying the Paralysis condition to the target.
otherEffects: On the turn the Move is charged, the user has Advantage (+4) to Evasion.
description: Bounces up, then down the next turn. May paralyze.

name: Spikes
official: Ground | Status | Accuracy — | PP 20 | Scatters spikes on the opposing side; switching in deals damage, up to 3 layers | No contact
otherEffects: Creates an area that lasts for 5 rounds. A character that enters the area or is inside the area during their End Phase takes 2 True Damage. A character can be affected by this Move multiple times per round.
description: Hurts foes when they switch in.

name: Destiny Bond
official: Ghost | Status | Accuracy — | PP 5 | If the user faints from a Move, the attacker faints too; lasts until the user’s next turn | Self
otherEffects: If a Move used by another character reduces the user to 0 HP, that character is also reduced to 0 HP. The effect lasts until the start of the user’s next Action Phase.
description: The foe faints if the user does.

name: Endeavor
official: Normal | Physical | Power — | Accuracy 100% | PP 5 | Damage equal to the difference between the target’s and the user’s current HP | Contact
otherEffects: The Move’s Power equals the user’s missing HP. The target can add their missing HP to their Defense Power against this Move.
description: Gains power if the user’s HP is lower than the foe’s HP.

name: Counter
official: Fighting | Physical | Power — | Accuracy 100% | PP 20 | Priority -5 | Deals twice the damage the user last took from a Physical Move | Contact
otherEffects: The Move’s Power equals twice the damage the user took from the last Physical Move during the ongoing or the previous round.
description: Returns a physical blow double.
